channel.title: Alvagante News of the Day
channel.description: Daily AI-assisted news digest from Alvagante.

item.title: OpenAI named a Leader in enterprise coding agents by Gartner
item.description: OpenAI is named a leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, with Codex recognized for innovation and enterprise-scale deployment.

item.title: How Virgin Atlantic ships faster with Codex
item.description: How Virgin Atlantic used Codex to ship its revamped mobile app on a fixed holiday travel deadline, reaching near-total unit test coverage and zero P1 defects.

item.title: AdventHealth advances whole-person care with OpenAI
item.description: AdventHealth is using ChatGPT for Healthcare to streamline workflows, reduce administrative burden, and return more time to patient care.

item.title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
item.description: An OpenAI model solved the 80-year-old unit distance problem, disproving a major conjecture in discrete geometry and marking a milestone in AI-driven mathematics.

item.title: The next phase of OpenAI’s Education for Countries
item.description: OpenAI advances Education for Countries, expanding AI adoption in schools with new partnerships, teacher training, and tools to improve global learning outcomes.

item.title: How Ramp engineers accelerate code review with Codex
item.description: How Ramp engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to review code and ship improvements, allowing them to get substantive feedback in minutes instead of hours.

item.title: Ghost CMS SQL injection flaw exploited in large-scale ClickFix campaign
item.description: A large-scale campaign is exploiting a critical SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-26980) in Ghost CMS to inject malicious JavaScript code that triggers ClickFix attack flows. [...]

item.title: Laravel Lang packages hijacked to deploy credential-stealing malware
item.description: A supply chain attack targeting the Laravel Lang localization packages has exposed developers to a sophisticated credential-stealing malware campaign after attackers abused GitHub version tags to distribute malicious code through Composer packages. [...]

item.title: Italy disrupts CINEMAGOAL piracy app that stole streaming auth codes
item.description: Italian authorities have dismantled a piracy ecosystem centered around the CINEMAGOAL app that provided access to various streaming platforms, including Netflix, Disney+, and Spotify. [...]

item.title: Netherlands seizes 800 servers of hosting firm enabling cyberattacks
item.description: Financial crime investigators in the Netherlands (FIOD) arrested two men and seized 800 servers linked to a web hosting company that enabled cyberattacks, interference operations, and disinformation campaigns. [...]

item.title: Former US execs plead guilty to aiding tech support scammers
item.description: Two former executives of a call-tracking and analytics company pleaded guilty to concealing a years-long tech support fraud scheme that victimized individuals worldwide. [...]

item.title: Trend Micro warns of Apex One zero-day exploited in the wild
item.description: Japanese cybersecurity software company Trend Micro has addressed an Apex One zero-day vulnerability exploited in attacks targeting Windows systems. [...]
